name: Ardin
message: 「They say the weak are quick on their feet when running away, and I've learned firsthand how true that is!」

name: Ardin
message: 「The Student Council, indulging in all manner of perverted acts against poor, fragile Pasta-chan--just as you'd expect from a bunch of cowards who only use underhanded tricks, their running away is first-rate!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Even someone as great as me was led around by the nose mercilessly」

name: Ardin
message: 「Last night, I fell right into their trap and wasted my stamina. Getting the drop on me--I'll give them credit for doing well for a bunch of shallow-minded, cowardly humans」

name: Ardin
message: 「Because the great me is a humble man who bestows praise whenever he finds a virtue, no matter how shitty the enemy!」

name: Ardin
message: 「However, if I lie in ambush all day long, even they will have to show themselves eventually! Because the great me isn't just humble, I'm patient too! How clever of me!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Nooow then. While I wait, a quick nap... and there」

name: Eddie
message: 「Over and done with. Synn. Wanna go to karaoke for the first time in forever? I found a free pass」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Um. Guys, it's still only the first day, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, do your best even after I get kicked out of the Student Council!」
Better not ask how it went.

name: Synn
message: 「H-How did it go for you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. So you've been going at it hard」

name: Melilot
message: 「Would you please stop having such subtly vulgar conversations?」

name: Melilot
message: 「You don't need to understand. Here you go」
I'm grateful, sure, but I'd better never ask what's in it. That's what being an adult is.
Before Nanaka, who had been hiding in the shadow of the bookshelf, could run away, Melilot's right hand grabbed her by the scruff of her neck.

name: Synn
message: 「What's up, Nanaka? If you wanted to study together, you should've just said so」
Melilot's left hand moved at lightning speed and dragged out Lolotte, who had been hiding under the desk.

name: Azel
message: 「You were supposed to be studying with Shio」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-Because the shrine maiden is so strict! Going, 'Lady Lolotte! Write this out 100 times. Do 100 practice swings'」

name: Azel
message: 「That's because your grades are far too terrible」

name: Melilot
message: 「Everyone, please apply yourselves to your studies until closing time. However, do keep quiet at all times」
Saying that, Melilot-san retreated behind the counter.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn!? What is this black tea! Just one sip and I'm feeling super energized」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauuuuuu! My eyes are wide awake! And I feel like I can do anything! Could this be the forbidden co― written about in the guidebook―」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Ah, Jiiya. Huh, to the librarian?」

name: Melilot
message: 「......Yes. You're quite the worrywart. This much won't cause an addiction」
For some reason, Melilot-san took away Lolotte's portion of the black tea.

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm just going to swap it out. Also, please turn off your phone in the library」
So it really is dangerous after all.

name: Synn
message: 「So, what parts do you two not understand?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In other words, teach me from here to here in my notebook」

name: Azel
message: 「Lolotte is in a different grade, so studying together is pointless」

name: Lolotte
message: 「On the contrary. Since you're all upperclassmen, you should be able to answer all of my questions」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer? Why are you looking away? Treasurerrr」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe that black tea helped. My concentration didn't break once」

name: Azel
message: 「Why not? It gets rid of fatigue and drowsiness」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, I'm surprised. You guys actually spent the whole time studying」

name: Synn
message: 「It is a study session, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. Pillow fights are for sleepovers」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Remind me who brought a pillow last time?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't worry, Treasurer. You don't think in the first place, after all」
Under the table, someone gave my pants a light tug.
When I looked up, Azel was looking my way.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it that late already? Well, see you later, Synn」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Are the two of you on patrol together today? That sounds tough.」
I wonder why Azel tugged on my pants.
Even without doing something like that, I would've walked him home properly.
On the lonely sports ground devoid of club members, the long shadow of the basketball hoop looked like a giant.
Azel's words are short. Still, I've gotten better at understanding him than before.

name: Azel
message: 「This is the last time we'll walk side by side too」

name: Synn
message: 「If it gets late, I'll walk you home again」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's just say we're both reckless」

name: Synn
message: 「See you, Azel! Tomorrow's the last day of exams, so do your best」

name: Azel
message: 「I-It's not like I did anything to be thanked for」
